name: base-defence-stop
description: The player's orders beat the home guard. Like base-defence: four idle tanks 26 m from the bunker are called up when an enemy bunker shoots a pylon, but the player stops them on the way, about 10 m out (tanks drive 3 m/s), before either side can see the other. Stopped tanks must stay where they are, neither finishing the trip nor being walked back to their post, and the bunker lives.

checks.name: the tanks had left their post
the stopped tanks did not go on to the bunker
the stopped tanks were not walked back to their post
